title: Hard Times
originalStudentTask: Fill in time, activity, and clock entries to create an ideal Sunday schedule; draw clocks indicating scheduled whole/half hours.

teacherRubric.required: The learner chooses an original sequence of Sunday activities and explicitly records each event and time; not just reading a system-generated clock.
Each drawn hour/minute hand accurately corresponds to the written o'clock or half-hour time; half past has minute hand at six and hour hand between consecutive hour numerals.
Schedule order is coherent and labels distinguish activities from their associated times; teacher can discuss learner choices.
The pupil supplies a time, activity label and analog-clock diagram for relevant rows.
Physical class discussion and genuine pupil-drawn schedules can be verified if and when teacher actually observes them; never synthesize child work as CI evidence.

notes: Digital time reading is assessed and persisted separately. This rubric documents the original authored school schedule learning target and teacher review readiness, not fake pupil UAT.
